GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-09-15T15:52:57Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: File in use issues in V5
Description: I am using LiteDB in a simple desktop app that uses 2 shared db files on an EMC Isilon (CIFS and NFS) file share.

I upgraded to V5 recently, largely to use LiteDB Studio and for a couple of features like DeleteMany.

Now my users are continually getting transient "file in use" errors trying the read or update the files. Error msgs include.

"The process cannot access the file .. because it is being used by another process"
"Access to the path is denied"

All LiteDB access is done inside Using blocks. I do a db.Commit() after each transaction.

I  open/connected to  the file in LiteDB Studio and queried it using Direct mode. When I disconnect I got the "Access to the path is denied" error. Next time I tried in Shared mode and got the access denied just trying to connect to file.

The locked condition seems to persist for an indeterminant period of time even when no one accesses the file.

Has anyone seen this behavior and/or have a way to work around it?

I am having a hard time determining if is enviornmental or something I am doing wrong.

I never saw this in the same environment in 18 months of using LiteDB V4.

You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly:

CATEGORY: [category number]
